fit.objective: mean total variation on the padded GHZ FIT jobs

identifiability.assumption: Qubits without an anomaly are assumed to have no X-gate error; the X bit-flip is therefore a lower bound there.
identifiability.one_qubit_gate_error: not fitted: on the padded GHZ jobs a uniform 1q depolarizing term is collinear with the CX term, so the fit keeps it at 0 and reports this rather than inventing a split.
identifiability.statement: OQ-02's marginal on an anomalous qubit is not a readout probability: OQ-03 reproduces the flip with a single X and OQ-09 (no X) does not. p10 for those qubits is fitted on the GHZ ladder; the X bit-flip is solved from OQ-02/OQ-03.

warnings: M-FIT-2 is post-hoc: it was written after the 25 jobs existed, so the EVAL score is exploratory, not a preregistered confirmation.
One backend, one day, 1000 shots per job. No drift or T1/T2 claim.
Readout inversion is an assumption, not a measurement of the true state.
Qubit(s) 0 show a circuit-dependent flip that is attributed to the X gate, not to readout. See identifiability.
